extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders and regulated entities (industry, state governments), legal researchers, members of the public who follow or participate in federal rulemaking for deepwater ports
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register notice formally withdrawing a previously published Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) concerning regulations for deepwater ports; documents the withdrawal, legal authority, docket availability, background, and related materials. Useful for parties tracking the rulemaking, submitting comments, or relying on the CFR provisions referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal status of FederalRegister.gov XML rendition
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays a prototype of a “Web 2.0” version of the daily Federal Register. It is not an official legal edition of the Federal Register, and does not replace the official print version or the official electronic version on GPO’s govinfo.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice to the public or judicial notice to the courts until the Administrative Committee of the Federal Register (ACFR) issues a regulation granting it official legal status. Those relying on it for legal research should verify results against an official edition of the Federal Register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of official PDF on govinfo.gov for legal/official citation
rubrics_metrics.description: Each document posted on the site includes a link to the corresponding official PDF file on govinfo.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar (govinfo) for the official electronic format; verify contents against the final official edition when conducting legal research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document Headings content and drafting guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Headings vary by document type but may contain the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; the RIN which identifies each regulatory action listed in the Unified Agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Document Drafting Handbook for more details on required/appropriate headings and drafting practices for Federal Register documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'deepwater port' (scope/applicability)
rubrics_metrics.description: A deepwater port is any fixed or floating manmade structure other than a vessel, or a group of such structures located beyond State seaward boundaries and used or intended for use as a port or terminal for the transportation, storage, or further handling of oil or natural gas for transportation to or from any State, except as otherwise provided in the Deepwater Port Act of 1974, as amended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This definitional standard determines whether structures fall within the regulatory scope of 33 CFR parts 148, 149, and 150.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal action and rationale
rubrics_metrics.description: The Coast Guard is withdrawing its notice of proposed rulemaking (NPRM) titled 'Deepwater Ports' that we published on April 9, 2015 because the Coast Guard concluded that it will not be pursuing the proposed changes at this time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Withdrawal places the previously proposed changes on hold; the Coast Guard may issue a new rulemaking in the future if warranted and will continue to engage with stakeholders regarding potential revisions to Subchapter NN. Existing regulations remain in effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket availability and access instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: The docket for this withdrawn proposed rule is available at the Federal eRulemaking Portal at www.regulations.gov. Please search for docket number USCG-2012-0061.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments and supporting materials referenced in the notice are available in the docket; stakeholders should consult the docket for the administrative record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment period and recordkeeping disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The comment period ended on July 8, 2015. The Coast Guard received 26 comments (including two duplicate submissions) on our April 2015 NPRM. The comments are available in the docket.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal Register notices should state comment-period dates, report receipt counts (including duplicates), and point readers to the docket where comments are lodged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority citation and adherence to APA procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice is issued under authority of 5 U.S.C. 552(a) and is consistent with the procedures set forth in 5 U.S.C. 553 of the Administrative Procedure Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal agencies must state the statutory authority for actions (withdrawal, publication, etc.) and ensure actions conform to APA requirements for notice-and-comment rulemaking or withdrawal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification under Executive Order 14192 and OMB guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: The withdrawal of this NPRM is an Executive Order 14192 deregulatory action. See Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Memorandum M-25-20, 'Guidance Implementing Section 3 of Executive Order 14192, Titled ‘Unleashing Prosperity Through Deregulation’' (March 26, 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should reference applicable EO/OMB guidance when classifying regulatory actions (e.g., deregulatory actions) and update the Unified Agenda accordingly (here: classify the corresponding Unified Agenda entry as a completed action).

rubrics_metrics.name: Public inspection listing and legal notice advisory
rubrics_metrics.description: This PDF is FR Doc. 2025-16597 as it appeared on Public Inspection on 08/28/2025 at 8:45 am. If you are using public inspection listings for legal research, you should verify the contents of the documents against a final, official edition of the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of supporting documents (e.g., environmental checklist)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting Documents: Environmental Checklist for Deepwater Ports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rulemakings affecting ports and infrastructure commonly include environmental analyses/checklists; such supporting documents are part of the administrative record and should be made available in the docket.
